data_rows.content_title: Implementation of Mandatory Notice Period Policy
data_rows.content_text:
This is to inform all employees of United Exploration India Pvt. Ltd. that, with effect from 1st September 2025, the following policy regarding notice periods will be applicable:

  1. Confirmed Employees: A mandatory notice period of two (2) months is required to be served.

  2. Probationary Employees: A mandatory notice period of fifteen (15) days is required to be served.

Please note that:

  • Failure to comply with the stipulated notice period will result in non-release of the Full & Final settlement and no issuance of a release order.

  • This policy supersedes all previous amendments or communications regarding notice periods.

All employees are advised to take due note of the above and ensure strict adherence.

 

By Order of Management
United Exploration India Pvt. Ltd.

data_rows.content_title: Advisory on Maintaining Discipline and Professional Conduct
data_rows.content_text:
Dear Team,

It has been observed with concern that certain instances of indiscipline and agitation have been occurring among employees in recent times. Such conduct not only hampers the smooth functioning of work but also affects the overall work environment and team morale.

All employees are hereby advised to exercise restraint and maintain decorum at the workplace at all times. Any form of indiscipline, disruptive behaviour, or agitation will be viewed seriously and may invite disciplinary action as per company policies.

We expect every team member to uphold the values and professional standards of United Exploration India Pvt. Ltd. and to address any grievance through proper channels rather than resorting to disruptive actions.

Let us work together to maintain a harmonious and productive work environment.

For any concerns or issues, employees are encouraged to reach out to their respective supervisors or the HR Department.

 

Regards,

Administration

data_rows.content_title: Project Schedule and Way Forward - as on 18th June 2023
data_rows.content_text:
Dear Team,

In order to have a best and efficient output of our resources aiming towards realization of the project costs, a function wise schedule of workings has been provided below:

As on 18th June, 2023 

Exploratory Works:
    1. The ongoing Jamkhani Drilling Job needs to be completed within  end of this month. It has been observed with Vedanta and BGR’s feedback that requisite documentation has not been completed by exploration team which includes basic MPR and DPR Submission. It is advised to complete all documentation in order latest by 20th June, 2023. In this regard, all supportive documents needs to be compiled with time sequence which attributes the delay in project works. Sampling and other jobs which are delayed must be covered up in order to complete the job on time.
    2. Rigs with accessories shall be taken out from Jamkhani site as soon the field activities are completed.
    3. Survey work needs to be completed for the remaining parts at the earliest.
    4. Hindalco Ongoing Drilling Job needs to be closed by end of June with proper documentation and discussion.
    5. Efforts must be put forward to maximise drilling job in Insitu Mineral Prospects of West Bengal.
 
Geological Reports – Coal & Lignite: 
    1. Basic Model with updated boreholes of Jamkhani Coal block needs to be submitted to Vedanta latest by 25th of June, 2023. The final GR which needs to be certified from MOC needs to be submitted to Vedanta by 15th July, 2023.
    2. Mata Sukh Lignite Project of RSML needs to be completed by 31st July, 2023.
    3. Ghala Lignite GR needs to be submitted to CMPDIL latest by 20th June, 2023.
    4. Khadsalya Lignite GR needs to be re-casted in line with MOC’s requirement and to be submitted for vetting. A line in confirmation needs to be obtained from GHCL beforehand. Ms. Sigma Dwivedy shall process in consultation with the undersigned.
    5. Brinda Sisai Geological Report to be re-casted based on the present day guideline. The job needs to be completed within end of August, 2023.
 
Coal – Lignite Mining Plans: 
    1. Damlai Mining Plan needs to be uploaded in the portal latest by 19th June, 2023.
    2. Ghala Mining Plan needs to be uploaded in the portal latest by 23rd June, 2023.
    3. Marki Mangli Plan needs to be submitted in portal latest by 7th July, 2023.
    4. Panandhro Extension Mining Plan needs to be suitably addressed and closed.
    5. Umarsar Lignite Mining Plan needs to be submitted in the portal latest by 10th of July, 2023. All works related to this project must be completed beforehand including obtaining GMDC Board Approval. This work exclusively to be undertaken by Ms. Swastika Kundu under the guidance of undersigned.
 
Environmental Projects: 
    1. Ensure Uploading of TOR application of Damlai by 19th June, 2023. Through CEMC.
    2. Ensure Uploading of TOR Application of Ghala by 22nd June, 2023. Through CEMC.
    3. Ensure Uploading of TOR Application of Panandhro Extension by 25th of June, 2023. Through CEMC.
    4. Ensure Uploading of TOR application of Lakhpat Limestone additional TOR by 24th June, 2023. Through CEMC.
    5. Submission of WBMDTCL Sand Projects Draft EIA EMP – Phase wise reports should be submitted latest by end of July, 2023. Report submission must be commencing from last week of June, 2023.
    6. Ms. Ambalika Neogi needs to call ND International to our office for baseline information data handing over for all our projects.
    7. Lakhpat Punrajpur EIA EMP to be submitted by mid of August, 2023. Through CEMC.
    8. Damlai EIA EMP to be submitted by End of August, 2023. Through CEMC.
    9. Ghala EIA- EMP to be submitted by Mid of September 2023. Through CEMC.
    10. Panandhro Extension EIA EMP to be submitted by End of September, 2023. Through CEMC.
    11. Minor Minerals EC Projects shall be evaluated and completed on dynamic basis. Environment team needs to work in a group with Dr. Sukhen Majumder and Ms. Swastika Kundu.  
    12. EC projects for Stone Crusher Units needs to be completed time to time – a proper coordination with complete data transparency should be maintained with RIAN Environics.
 
Minor Mineral Geological Reports: 
    1. Existing Projects for GR preparation including Exploration needs to be completed on routine basis -  per week two reports. Regularization of work order and realization must be done together. Mr. Animesh Basu needs to be assigned in order to make the proper documentation.
    2. Bhjitarya Granite Project report to be completed and submitted latest by 23rd June, 2023. Responsibility – Ms. Swastika Kundu.  
 
Minor Mineral Mining Plan  Projects – WBMDTCL & Others:
    1. All existing projects Mining Plans must be completed by end of June, 2023 – this includes Malibona Silica Sand, Asanbani Blackstone project, riverbed projects of WBMDTCL & Others.
    2. Asanbani Mining Plan must be submitted in final copies latest by 21st June, 2023.
    3. Dhatla Mining Plan must be made ready latest by 25th of June, 2023.
    4. Purulia Kehndajhor Mining Plan must be made ready by 1st week of July, 2023.
 
Non Coal Major Mineral Projects: 
    1. Lakhpat Limestone Mining Plan must be submitted with due discussion with GMDC latest by end of June, 2023. Mr. Deep Konar needs to take up this assignment under the guidance of Mr. Saibal Mukhopadhyay.
    2. Panandhro Extension Mining Plan must be submitted to GMDC for review latest by 26th of June, 2023.
    3. Damlai Silica Sand Mining Plan needs to be prepare as per the provision of Gujarat Minor Mineral Concession Rules and to be submitted at GMDC latest by 1st Week of July, 2023.
    4. Rowghat DPR – needs to be re-evaluated once again in case of repetition of jobs or additional jobs – a comprehensive analysis of previously submitted data and present day ongoing exercises needs to be  done by 22nd June, 2023. Deep Konar and Sigma Dwivedy needs to prepare this document in consultation with Mr. Saibal Mukhopadhyay.
 
Survey and GIS related jobs: 
    1.  All maps related to CA land needs to be finalized with respect to Pachwara South Coal Project. By 21st June, 2023. Jinia Rahaman & Rabiul Islam.
    2. All maps related to CA land needs to be finalized  with respect to Banhardih Coal Project. By end of June, with proper discussion with PVUNL. Ishani Choudhury.
    3. Existing Forest Related documents needs to be checked and verified for making the way forward with respect to Brinda Sisai Coal Project – Ishani Choudhury – suitable assistance from Kumar Hrithik.
    4. Finalisation of Cadastral map of Brinda Sisai Coal Block in GIS Platform  – Ishani Choudhury, by Mid of July, 2023.
    5. Finalisation of Cadastral map of Banhardih Coal Project w.r.t change in Land Schedule as per Forest Record – Ishani Choudhury, by end of July, 2023.
    6. Survey work completion at Jamkhani Coal Block by mid of July, 2023 – Rabiul Islam.
    7. Survey Work at Brinda Sisai Coal Block – DGPS for Boundary Survey and Dron for Topographical Survey – project completion by End of July, 2023. Responsibility  Amit Mridha.
    8. Forest Patch Demarcation in Banhardih Coal Project – with pillar coordinates and ground demarcation – Responsibility - Ishani Choudhury and Rabiul Islam.
    9. Forest Patch Demarcation within the Mining Lease boundary - with pillar coordinates and ground demarcation in Brinda Sisai Coal Block – Responsibility – Ishani Choudhury & Amit Mridha.
    10. Obtaining Geo Coordinates of Proposed CA Lands of Banhardih Coal Project – Ishani Choudhury and Rabiul Islam.
 
Coal Bid Advisory, Feasibility Report  & MDO support etc. :
    1. Bid Advisory to RRUVNL – responsibility Saibal Mukhopadhyay & team. 17th & 18th Tranch Support.
    2. Closing of Pachwara South Feasibility report – Gourab Das & Mehedi Hasan.
    3. DPR for Pachwara South Coal Project for MIPL-GCL – Mr. Saibal Mukhopadhyay & Team. Draft report to be closed by Mid of August, 2023. Final Report by October, 2023 after obtaining due vetting remarks from Client.
    4. To complete Feasibility report of Bharkhandam Project – Responsibility Mr. Saibal Mukhopadhya & Team.
 
Business Development:
    1.  Efforts to put on at least two coal exploration project by September, 2023. Estimated Drilling meterage around 25000, out of which 15000 meters of drilling must be undertaken in this financial year with a job value of around 8 Cr. Additional investment to execute the jobs are on discussion and can be confirmed on getting the job order. Responsibility - Joydeep Banerjee, Satyavrat Singh and Mr. Subir Chandra.
    2. Efforts to put around 8000 meter drilling projects in Non Coal Sector.  Preferred domain – Aditya Birla Group, Vedanta Group, Hindustan Copper, MOIL. Responsibility – Joydeep Banerjee, Debnath Adhikary & Satyavrat Singh.
    3. To go for at least another 6 Mining Plans in Coal & Lignite this year with an estimated Job value of Rs. 75 Lakhs. Responsibility – Joydeep Banerjee &  Mr. Subir Chandra, suitably assisted by Mr. Animesh Basu.
    4. Target to get at least 70 Lakhs additional Job order from Insitu Minor Mineral in West Bengal. Dr. Sukhen Majumder and Mr. Mala Jana.
    5. Target to get at least 2000 meters of drilling in Insitu Minerals in West Bengal through deployment of our old rigs – Estimated job value – Rs. 60.00 Lakhs. Responsibility- Mr. Debnath Adhikary, Dr. Sukhen Majumder & Mr. Malay Jana.
    6. To participate in Government tenders for a Job value of More than 5 Crores to achieve at least 1 Cr. Work order. Responsibility – Mr. Debkumar Chatterjee & Mr. Animesh Basu.
    7. To get at least two ground water projects in this financial year with an estimated Job value of Rs. 50 Lakhs. Responsibility – Dr. Sukhen Majumder, Mr. Animesh Basu and Mr. Arijit Dey.
 
Administration and Resource Management:
    1. To put additional Directors in the Company Board. – Joydeep Banerjee, Mr. Satyavrat Singh & Mr. Sujit Das.
    2. To regularize Periodical Board meeting happening in Physical Form with recording as per Statute. – Mr. Arijit Dey & Mr. Sujit Das.
    3. Preparation of annual Statutory Return Matrix – putting the same in the Company Portal Module with reminder system in place – Joydeep Banerjee & Mr. Arijit Dey.
    4. Development of Annual Budgeting and Monitoring System in the Company Portal. Shall be developed by End of September and must be effective from 1st of October, 2023. – Joydeep Banerjee & Arijit Dey.  
    5. To establish the working relationship with Russian Group of Companies – Finalised structure in India – Mr. Satyavrat Singh & Mr. Joydeep Banerjee by End of August, 2023.
    6. Review report on the existing human resources, transfer planning and redistribution of the team for effective utilization to maximise productivity. Responsibility - Mr. Arijit Dey – by 25th of June, 2023.
    7. Hiring of a Senior Level Professional to Generate Business and look after the Exploration Division as a whole. – Mr. Joydeep Banerjee, Mr. Satyavrat Singh & Mr. Arijit Dey.
    8. Migration of Database of the organisaiton to Internal Server. Mr. Nasim Akhtar. – By end of June, 2023.
    9. Impart training with respect to ISO and NABET Certification in all three accredited donmains. Mr. Subir Chandra & Mr. Arijit Dey.  
    10. Create a functional team for Monthly Audit and Documentation as per NABET & ISO requirement – Mr. Subir Chandra and Mr. Arijit Dey.
    11. Updating and creating Travel Policy, IT Policy, Dress Code etc. – Mr. Arijit Dey.
    12. Procurement & Implementation of Arc GIS Software. – Mr. Debkumar Chatterjee and Ishani Choudhury.
    13. Implementation of Surpac Software for UG Mine Designing – Mr. Saibal Mukhopadhyay, Mr. Shouri Dutta  and Mr. Deep Konar.
    14. Increase the effectivity of QA/QC Team – Mrs. Debika Choudhury & Dr. Sigma Dwivedy.
    15. A proper QA/QC Policy has to be defined with a SOP - Mr. Subir Chandra & Mr. Arijit Dey.
    16. Preparation of Project Monitoring Schedule in MS Project with proper tagging of Link activities.
    17. Effective implementation of office discipline. Mr. Arijit Dey.  
 
Stores, Finance & Accounts Management:
    1.  To prepare Monthly report on Invoice Schedule and Payment realization scenario latest by 3rd of month for preceding period. Both for preceding month and cumulative annual figures to be included.
    2. Monthly Report on Store with new purchase, scrap and reconciliation reports. Reports to be prepared by Debkumar Chatterjee, and to be verified or audited by Mr. Mehedi Hassan and Mr. Gourab Chandra Das. A monthly report must be documented.
    3. Fund requirement for subsequent month must be placed latest by 25th of Month.  – responsibility Mr. Debkumar Chatterjee.
    4. Routine Follow up for Payments – Mr. Debkumar Chatterjee through Mr. Animesh Basu.
    5. Sending reports to all HOD’s stating project completion status as per schedule or deviation reports on monthly basis. Successive deviations on timeline failures must be recorded by HR & Admin for future appraisal.
    6. Arrangement for Fund as working capital and management of the same through timely servicing – Mr. Debkumar Chatterjee.
    7. Assessment of the long outstanding open projects and closing of the same through proper documentation. By end of September, 2023- Mr. Debkumar Chatterjee.

The above list may require modifications after review by the team. Team members are advised to send individual mails to Mr. Arijit Dey with a copy to undersigned in order to include the same in the calendar. Mr. Arijit Dey to finalise a schedule of the above projects with their invoice schedule and present on 24th of June ( Saturday).

With regards,

Joydeep Banerjee
